floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a Verdes by Haven floor plan
floorPlans.note: The figures are the published average gross floor areas in square feet, excluding balconies. Confirm the signed plan and area for your apartment.

review.images: Aldar’s Verdes microsite supplies the project-specific elevations and interiors. The official brochure supplies the yoga studio and context aerial, exported from embedded JPEG 2000 images as lossless WebP. Generic lifestyle images were excluded.
review.location: The project brochure page 8 provides a dedicated aerial of Verdes within Haven. The developer launch page gives 25 minutes to Downtown Dubai. A geographic pin for any building was not confirmed.
review.floorPlans: Visually checked all eight plan pages on physical pages 32–39. Areas use the square feet as printed under average GFA, excluding balcony. The brochure’s one-bedroom metric equivalent is printed as 67 m². No conversion or signed-unit area was substituted.

unavailable: Verified building entrances and signed unit dimensions.
